description:
Live in harmony with nature and modern elegance in this exclusive development where design and innovation come together for an extraordinary lifestyle. Situated on a sprawling 31,000-square-metre plot, this community of stunning Mijas Costa apartments with sea views offers nine architecturally optimised buildings with units ranging from one to three bedrooms, blending functionality, natural light, and cutting-edge design, ensuring each home is a sanctuary of modern living.

Enjoy a wealth of exceptional amenities designed for your well-being and leisure. Dive into the two pristine saltwater pools, including a stunning infinity lap pool, or rejuvenate in the expansive 300-square-metre wellness area. Here, you will find a state-of-the-art gym bathed in natural light, a heated indoor pool, and a sauna complete with changing and shower facilities. For social and professional engagements, the community offers a contemporary co-working space and a chic lounge featuring an outdoor kitchen and chill-out zone, perfect for gatherings. Technology, health, security, and design converge in these apartments to create an exceptional living environment. Each unit includes a garage space, with optional storerooms available, ensuring ample storage and convenience.

Residents can embrace an active and balanced lifestyle with amenities including an open-air yoga terrace, a children’s play area, and a versatile beach-sand court suitable for volleyball or padel tennis. Golf enthusiasts can refine their skills on the dedicated putting green, while those with a green thumb will appreciate the organic vegetable gardens. Tranquil reading areas and scenic trails meander through the community, connecting the apartments with the abundant natural surroundings.

Ideally located near top golf courses and just one kilometre from the upcoming Gran Parque Costa del Sol—Mijas Costa’s largest landscaped park—this vibrant area offers artificial lakes, an amphitheatre, sports facilities, and lush greenery with over 2,000 trees and 20,000 plants, earning its title as the “green lung of Mijas.” Meanwhile, the coastal towns of La Cala de Mijas and Fuengirola, only three kilometres away, boast pristine beaches and diverse dining options. Marbella is just 20 kilometres away, while Malaga Airport can be reached in 25 minutes, ensuring excellent connectivity.

This thoughtfully designed community will enhance your lifestyle every day. With premium amenities, a prime location, and a focus on comfort and convenience, this is where modern living meets natural beauty. Don’t miss your chance to secure a home in this exceptional Mijas Costa development. Contact us today to learn more and take the first step toward your new way of living.
